synthesis:draft.headline: Victoria's dispatch RRP reached -504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (interval end).
summary: Deepest five-minute dispatch price: -504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z (2026-07-28 21:20 AEST).
Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (half-hour ending 2026-07-28T11:30:00Z) was 7491.0 MW (get_actual_demand).
Maximum operational demand in the reviewed window was 8131.0 MW (get_actual_demand).

The find_market_events result uses a $0/MWh analysis threshold (evidence: threshold = 0.0 $/MWh) and lists 23 episodes; examples of per-episode counts include 101 intervals (ev1024) and 57 intervals (ev1032).
AEMO market notices retrieved for VIC1 in the window report a non-credible contingency (Moorabool bus trip) and automated constraint sets invoked for inter-regional transfer (see published_findings).

possible_explanations.statement: A brief surplus of supply relative to demand (high local generation or export conditions) might be associated with the negative RRP at 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z; compare 5-minute dispatch TOTALDEMAND and NETINTERCHANGE at 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z to test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain 5-minute dispatch TOTALDEMAND and regional NETINTERCHANGE for interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z and check for simultaneous high net exports or low TOTALDEMAND.

possible_explanations.statement: Automated constraint sets invoked by AEMO (see notice [c2]) might have altered interconnector limits or dispatch outcomes and could be related to price behaviour in the window.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare dispatch outcomes and interconnector flows immediately before and after the constraint invocation reported in [c2] (use AEMO NOS and 5-minute NETINTERCHANGE/dispatch data for times the notice shows).

possible_explanations.statement: Unit output changes observed in SCADA (get_generation_change) could be relevant to the negative-price episodes and might explain some episodes' durations.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine the 5-minute SCADA generation outputs for units with large changes in the window (e.g. entries with evidence ev0948 and ev0936) and compare their timestamps to negative-price intervals such as 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z.
